dedupe_keys.name: last mile relief aid distribution instances for kartal istanbul and the 2011 van earthquake branch and price study

description: This repository publishes the two instance sets used in the paper Branch-and-Price Algorithm for Fast and Equitable Last-Mile Relief Aid Distribution, released to support research on fair and fast delivery of relief supplies after disasters. It is maintained on GitHub by the account mahdims. Coverage: a Kartal dataset for a district of Istanbul, Turkey, with 12 selected shelter locations, their estimated relief demand and coordinates, vehicle capacity, maximum travel time and depot supply, with distances along actual transport routes allowing for possible road closures after an earthquake; and a Van dataset built on the 2011 Van earthquake in eastern Turkey, with 94 demand points and one local distribution centre aggregated to 15, 30 and 60 demand nodes. Format and access: JSON instance files per region and aggregation level with a Python Data class to load them; free from GitHub. Licence: Apache-2.0 (LICENSE file). Caveats: the readme does not give the paper's full citation or journal, demand values are estimates, the instances are small and specific to two Turkish regions, and the repository has not changed since October 2024. Simulation uses: testing vehicle routing and equity-aware optimisation for post-earthquake relief logistics, supporting emergency response planning over damaged road networks. Related records: the Saltillo waste collection instances (data-saltillo-waste-collection-2ecvrp-if-instances) are another set of vehicle routing benchmark instances.
